title: Fibo 2.0 (Bria, 8B): research and bench it as an edit model against Qwen-Image 2.1, FLUX.3 Klein and Qwen-Edit-2511
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1179 - New Models to Test. Menu: tasks/MPI-1179/plan.md. FIRST TEST IS A GATE (Fabio, 2026-10-24): bench COMPLEX image edits only (multi-step, composition-heavy, multi-reference), never simple ones: simple edits are already covered by the models we ship. If Fibo fails the complex-edit test it is OUT, card closes rejected. Context: a video Fabio watched compared Fibo with MOSS-Image and Fibo lost on every t2i task, so t2i is not a reason to keep it. BLOCKED on the next engine bump past v0.42.1 (Fabio, 2026-10-24: deferred until it is stable; let the upstream bugs get fixed first, incl. ComfyUI #17248 int8 edit error). Bria's Fibo 2.0 (released 2026-10-20) is rated #1 open-weights image editor on the Artificial Analysis arena (vendor-cited snapshot, Elo 1087; ties Qwen-Image 2.1 on T2I). Two weights: Dev (t2i + edit, 50 steps cfg 5) and Edit Turbo (edit only, 4 steps cfg 1, up to 4 references). Licence CC BY-NC 4.0, gated on HF: would ship behind the non-commercial licence gate like Qwen-Image 2.1 and PiD. Native in ComfyUI master (PR 17240, 2026-10-21) but NOT in our pinned v0.42.1, so an engine bump is needed first. Reuses FLUX.2 VAE and a Qwen3-VL-4B encoder we already ship. Research notes: research.md in this card's folder.
